summary: Per-unit penalty for load over max_load (per dimension).
range: Array of integers, dimensions match max_load.
businessRules: load_penalty defines: Specify the penalty to be applied when a depot exceeds its max_load limit during any handling_duration interval. The penalty is applied for each excess unit of load. A penalty value must be provide…
Each element in load_penalty must be valid and consistent with related fields.
Must stay consistent with: depots.throughput.max_load. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
This is a soft constraint. Violations are penalized but don't make solutions infeasible.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Behavioral: scales with load overshoot at the depot.
